subtests.name: Navigating right should not wrap the focus to the first column when only vertical wrap is supported by the focusgroup.
When on the last row, navigating down should move the focus to first row if the focusgroup wraps vertically.
Navigating left should not wrap the focus to the last column when only vertical wrap is supported by the focusgroup.
When on the first row, navigating up should move the focus to last row if the focusgroup wraps vertically.
